semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in fluorine gas surface treatment technology that enhances material properties relevant to semiconductor applications.
summary: Takamatsu Teisan provides unique fluorine gas surface treatment technology that chemically modifies surfaces of various materials, primarily rubber and resin, without creating a distinct modified layer. This technology enhances properties such as slipperiness, hydrophilicity, and chemical resistance, making it applicable in semiconductor processes like plating adhesion improvement.
capabilities: Fluorine gas surface treatment for rubber and resin materials
Surface modification for improved hydrophilicity and chemical resistance
Pretreatment for plating processes to enhance adhesion

regional_presence.Japan: The company is the only provider of this unique technology in Japan, handling research, development, and processing.
